pr.title: Move console log API from ResourceViewModel to IResourceService
pr.author: drewnoakes

failed_jobs.name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Windows, browser-debugger)
failed_jobs.reason: The only failing test is the Blazor browser-debugger E2E test timing out waiting for a pwa-msedge child debug session/WASM root to become interactive. This matches a well-established recurring flaky pattern (25 prior occurrences) tracked as 'vscode-extension-e2e-unrelated-logs-unavailable'. The PR only changes Aspire.Dashboard console log/resource-service plumbing and Aspire.Hosting log source code, none of which touches the VS Code extension's Blazor WASM debugger or E2E harness.
